background: I have the required permissions to create and manage services
an organisation exists with at least one contract

scenarios.title: Open the service creation form
preconditions: I am viewing an existing contract
expectedResults: the new service form is displayed

scenarios.title: Verify available services in the Service dropdown
preconditions: an organisation has services linked in Organisation Settings
I am creating a new service under a contract
expectedResults: the services linked to the organisation should be displayed
I should be able to select an available service

scenarios.title: Verify behavior when a service is not linked in Organisation Settings
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
a service is not linked to the organisation in Organisation Settings
expectedResults: the unlinked service should not be available for selection
I should not be able to associate that service with the contract

scenarios.title: Verify available options in the Service Type dropdown
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
expectedResults: the available service types should be displayed
I should be able to select an appropriate service type

scenarios.title: Verify available locations in the Location dropdown
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
a valid location has been created in the Location tab
expectedResults: the created location should be available for selection
I should be able to associate the selected location with the service

scenarios.title: Accept 10-digit numeric DOS Service ID
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
actions: I enter a valid 10-digit numeric value in the DOS Service ID field
expectedResults: the service should be saved successfully
the DOS Service ID should be displayed correctly when viewing the service

scenarios.title: Validate mandatory service fields
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
actions: I leave a mandatory service field empty
expectedResults: the service is not saved
validation identifies the fields requiring completion

scenarios.title: Service opening/closing times can be selected or typed
preconditions: I am editing service opening hours
expectedResults: the value is accepted

scenarios.title: Service opening/closing dates can be selected or typed
preconditions: I am editing service opening dates
expectedResults: the value is accepted

scenarios.title: Prevent saving a service with an invalid date and time range
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
all mandatory fields contain valid values
actions: I enter an end date and time earlier than the start date and time
expectedResults: the service should not be saved
an appropriate validation message should be displayed

scenarios.title: Display saved service details in the service list
preconditions: I have successfully created a service under a contract
expectedResults: the Status should be displayed as Active, Inactive, or Expired as applicable
the Start Date should be displayed correctly
the End Date should be displayed correctly
the "Configure SLA" action should be available
the "Archive" action should be available
the "Edit" action should be available

scenarios.title: Create a service with a present/future start date
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
all mandatory fields contain valid values
actions: I set the service start date and time to a present/future point
I enter a valid end date and time
expectedResults: the service should be saved successfully
the service status should be "Inactive" before its start date and time

scenarios.title: Automatically activate a future-dated service
preconditions: a service has been created with a future start date and time
the service status is "Inactive"
actions: the configured start date and time is reached
expectedResults: the service status should automatically change to "Active"
the updated status should be displayed in the service list

scenarios.title: Display System One configuration fields
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
expectedResults: the Endpoint URL, Target ODS Code , Max Attempts field should be displayed

scenarios.title: Validate mandatory System One configuration fields
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
all standard mandatory fields contain valid values
"Enable System One Configuration" is enabled
expectedResults: the service should not be saved
a validation message should indicate that "<field>" is require

scenarios.title: Validate an invalid System One Endpoint URL
preconditions: System One configuration is enabled
all other mandatory fields contain valid values
actions: I enter an invalid Endpoint URL
expectedResults: the invalid URL should be rejected
an appropriate validation message should be displayed

scenarios.title: Validate the Target ODS Code
preconditions: System One configuration is enabled
actions: I enter "<value>" as the Target ODS Code
expectedResults: the value can accept alphanumeric characters

scenarios.title: Validate the Max Attempts field
preconditions: System One configuration is enabled
actions: I enter a non-numeric value in the Max Attempts field
expectedResults: the invalid input should be rejected and an appropriate validation message should be displayed

scenarios.title: Save a service with System One configuration disabled
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
all standard mandatory fields contain valid values
"Enable System One Configuration" is disabled
expectedResults: the service should be saved successfully

scenarios.title: Verify saved System One configuration
preconditions: a service has been saved with System One configuration enabled
actions: I reopen the service for editing
expectedResults: the System One configuration toggle should reflect the saved state
the saved Endpoint URL, Target ODS Code and   Max Attempts value should be displayed

scenarios.title: Discard unsaved service changes
preconditions: I am creating a new service under a contract
expectedResults: the unsaved changes are discarded

scenarios.title: Cancel the service form
preconditions: I am creating or editing a service under a contract
expectedResults: the service form closes without saving the entered details

scenarios.title: Verify saved service details
preconditions: a service has been saved under a contract
actions: I reopen or view the service
expectedResults: the selected service is displayed correctly

scenarios.title: Edit permitted service fields
preconditions: a service exists under a contract
I have permission to edit the service
actions: I open the service for editing
I update permitted service fields and save the changes
expectedResults: the changes are saved successfully
the updated details are displayed when I reopen the service

scenarios.title: Verify service association with the contract
preconditions: a service has been saved under a contract
actions: I view the services associated with that contract
expectedResults: the saved service appears under the correct contract
